title: munnozia nivea
intro: Munnozia nivea, commonly known as White Top, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The plant is also reported to possess therapeutic actions, including antiseptic, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can aid in wound healing and immune system support. Bioactive constituents present in Munnozia nivea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
